April 7, 2026 8:57pm ET. # Asian Stock Markets Are Also Soaring. President Trump's social-media post kicked off a global rally, with Japan's Nikkei recently up 4.4% and South Korea's Kospi adding around 5%. International stocks have been particularly hard hit by the Iran war, with investors fearing the recent surge in energy prices would slow growth around the world. The Nikkei and Kospi had lost 9% and 13%, respectively, from highs hit just before the conflict.
